nodes.label: D-35 Mark on deleted text disappears with it
nodes.rationale: Predictable and simple; alternatives (stick to neighbor char, lost-marks UI) rejected; partial deletion shrinks stroke; undo and version history restore mark

nodes.label: Stroke hidden (not erased) while anchors point to deleted chars
nodes.rationale: Undo (including on another device) restores mark automatically; final cleanup at history compaction
